quote: Up to now, Usuper Power has covered the full power range of 20kVA-2000kVA and can provide customized diesel generators, including open types, silent types, trailer types, container types, and an automated parallel system. All diesel generators will undergo a strict full-load test before leaving the factory
The Usuper Power diesel generator is compliant with global mainstream emission standards, such as CE and EPA.
We also provide full ODM&OEM customized services
500kVA Yuchai YC6T660L-D20 Generator Specs - Usuper Power

Powered by Yuchai’s YC6T 6-cylinder turbocharged intercooled engine, this generator delivers 400kW prime/440kW standby power at 50Hz/1500rpm (400V/230V, 0.8 lagging). It offers excellent fuel efficiency (195-210g/kWh), robust high-altitude performance (<5% power loss at 3000m), and optional -30℃ cold-start capability.

150kVA Yuchai YC6B205L-D20 Engine Generator - Usuper Power

150kVA Yuchai generator delivers 120kW prime/132kW standby power at 400V/230V 50Hz, powered by YC4A/YC6B turbocharged intercooled engines with high-pressure common rail technology. Equipped with 100% copper brushless alternator and a digital intelligent control system, it supports 110% overload for 1 hour and -15°C cold start, available in open, silent, trailer, and marine models.
250kVA Yuchai YC6MK350L-D20 Generator Specs - Usuper Power

250kVA Yuchai generator delivers 200kW prime/220kW standby power at 400V/230V 50Hz, powered by YC6MK 6-cylinder turbocharged intercooled engine with high-pressure common rail technology. It is available in open, silent, trailer, containerized, and marine models.

Usuper Power 625kVA Yuchai YC6TD840-D31 Generator Specs

The 625kVA Yuchai generator provides 500kW prime/550kW standby power, driven by Yuchai’s YC6TD turbocharged engine with low fuel consumption. Equipped with premium brushless alternators and digital controllers, it comes in open, silent, and trailer types.

The 1000kVA Yuchai diesel generator (800kW prime/880kW standby) is a reliable, fuel-efficient power solution from China’s leading engine manufacturer. Available in multiple configurations, this durable, low-maintenance generator provides prime/standby power for data centers, factories, hospitals, and infrastructure worldwide, backed by an extensive service network.
